text: carmen: Heads-up on a small but important a11y/copy issue in the threshold action row. When you open the channel preview the keyboard sequence skips the action buttons; screen reader also reads the channel count as 'button' instead of a descriptive phrase. Can we triage? noah: Repro steps please? I want to add a unit test. carmen: SLOs > Edit > click eye preview > Tab to preview and press Enter. Try Shift+Tab to go back. Focus ends up trapped in preview, action-row buttons unreachable until Esc. VoiceOver: reads count as "button 2 of 2". priya: I can repro. Preview is a floating panel that's focus-trapped; action row is a sibling outside overlay root. Quick fix = add a skip link at panel open that targets #threshold-actions so SR and keyboard users can jump back. kevin: Agree. Also for copy: the compact toggle currently says `Mute` which is too vague. Product suggests `Pause alerts` visually + hidden descriptive text for assistive tech: `Pause notifications for this SLO for the selected duration`. aria-bot: Accessibility note: add role="dialog" with aria-labelledby on the preview. For the channel count use aria-live="polite" and text like "Preview 11 channels configured" (reads as a sentence). Ensure toggle is a button with aria-pressed and aria-describedby referencing the hidden description. noah: Implementation plan: 1) inject a visible-on-focus skip link when preview opens; 2) add aria-labelledby to header and aria-live to count; 3) swap toggle to aria-pressed + aria-describedby and change visual label to `Pause alerts`. I'll open a small PR covering these. priya: For the skip link make the anchor tabbable (sr-only but focusable) and target `#threshold-actions` which should be `tabindex=-1` so we can focus it programmatically. Add a Cypress test for tab flow. kevin: On button copy, also expand 'Fallback' -> 'Fallback policy' and 'Assign' -> 'Assign owner' so voice reads are explicit. Short enough to fit the compact row. carmen: Thanks — prioritizing skip-link + aria-labelledby + toggle semantics + copy swaps for the patch. Follow-up: move action-row into overlay DOM to remove skip link reliance. noah: I'll write the tests. Drop the staging link here when ready and I'll run a quick NVDA pass. priya: I'll update the design tokens doc with the new labels and the SR doc snippet. kevin: Nice. LGTM. carmen: Closing when merged.
